name: hermeneutic-gate
description: Advisory-only Stop-hook drift gate for Codex — regex-only, zero-LLM, no network.

interface.shortDescription: Advises when fixed English drift patterns match a completed turn.
interface.longDescription: Runs the fixed, zero-model hermeneutic English regex gate over each final assistant message via a Stop hook. It is advisory: it never blocks or edits a turn and emits a system message when a pattern matches. The plugin contract is mechanically tested; live host behavior is not certified in v0.1.7.
interface.defaultPrompt: Gate my outgoing responses for overclaiming.
